title: Cloudless Voice - The Free Alternative to Wispr Flow
excerpt: Seriously fast voice dictation that runs locally on Mac, Windows and iOS. See what your laptop is capable of.
content_html:
/Claimed

Free for individual use on Mac, Windows, and iOS

Cloudless Voice

is

fast

dictation

that

runs

entirely

on

your

device.

No cloud

means

complete privacy

& no one

listening.

Speak

naturally

and

let

Smart Cleanup

do

the

rest.

All the

features

you

already

love

without the risks.

Smart Cleanup

Basic dictation just transcribes. Cloudless Voice makes it ready-to-send. Our custom-built local AI automatically polishes your transcript: filler words, formatting, punctuation. All without your voice ever leaving your Mac.

I've been, uh, working on a fix

Remove Filler Word

Let's sync at 9 am, no sorry, 10 am

Email Formatting

hey do you mind rescheduling our meeting for three thirty pm

Time Formatting

List Formatting

Advanced Punctuation

Hello!

there are three hundred forty six issues

Number Formatting

There are 346 issues.

100% Local

Runs fully on-device

Most voice apps send your audio and transcripts to the cloud (remote servers) for processing. Cloudless Voice runs entirely locally, so your voice and data never leaves your device.

Complete privacy

Works offline

No remote AI training

Cloudless Voice is sure to get the tick of approval from your company. With fully local processing, and open-source code to verify, we provide security that surpasses cloud-based dictation tools like Wispr Flow.

Our Enterprise Plan is for teams and organizations looking to adopt private and secure AI dictation into their workflow.

Features

More reasons to love Cloudless

Hotkey activation

Press & hold Caps Lock (customizable) to dictate, or double-tap for handsfree mode.

Light / dark mode

Built to work with your setup

Works in all apps and sites

Insert transcripts into any text field

Transcript history

View and manage past transcripts

❤️

Wall of love
